import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);

        long a = scanner.nextLong();
        long b = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();

        long bx = 0, by = 1;
        long bbi = 1;
        long eps = 1000000000L;

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long tx = (i * a) / b;

            for (int j = -5; j <= 5; j++) {
                long t = tx + j;
                long tbi = b * i;

                long diff = Math.abs(b * t - a * i);
                long left = diff * bbi;
                long right = eps * tbi;
                if (left < right) {
                    eps = diff;
                    bx = t;
                    by = i;
                    bbi = tbi;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bx + "/" + by);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
